positioning: Cinematic business documentaries about hidden leverage points in systems, business and government.
visual_reference: MagnatesMedia-style cinematic business documentary, adapted into Asymmetric's leverage framework.

advertiser_safety.criticize: mechanisms, incentives, control surfaces and cost transfers

episode_template.description: Ten-part leverage story structure. Required for all Asymmetric episodes.

steps.name: Consequence
steps.description: Open with a concrete verifiable outcome that proves the leverage exists. Already happened. Specific. Dramatic.

steps.name: First Receipt
steps.description: First primary-source evidence on screen. A document, filing, contract clause, or court record. Legible. Specific.

steps.name: Public Story
steps.description: The consensus narrative most people believe. State it fairly. No mockery.

steps.name: Hidden Mechanism
steps.description: How the system actually works beneath the public story. Provable. Diagram language. Every claim connects to a receipt.

steps.name: Control Surface
steps.description: Name and show the specific mechanism that concentrates control. Must appear as a visual close-up. Amber overlay.

steps.name: Dependency
steps.description: Show who depends on the control surface with no structural alternative.

steps.name: Cost Transfer
steps.description: Show who absorbs the cost the controlling entity avoids. Name the transfer. Use receipts.

steps.name: Beneficiary
steps.description: Name who captures the value the cost transfer creates. Specific entity, specific mechanism, documented magnitude where possible.

steps.name: Accountability Gap
steps.description: Explain why the mechanism escapes consequence. Structural, not personal.

steps.name: Leverage Takeaway
steps.description: Reusable operator-level mental model. What to watch for, what to ask, what to find. Informational and lawful.

openmontage_production_method.composition_remotion: Cinematic receipt cards, leverage maps, cost-transfer scenes, stat cards, source-proof scenes
openmontage_production_method.composition_hyperframes: Kinetic segment title cards and high-end typography inserts
openmontage_production_method.composition_ffmpeg: Assembly, finishing, loudness normalization (-14 LUFS integrated), QC — unless a stronger Remotion path is proven
openmontage_production_method.reference_analysis: Run VideoAnalyzer on 1-2 reference videos before scripting. Populate visual_rhythm_plan.json from reference metrics.
openmontage_production_method.creative_pass: Operator-only. No agent or tool may set creative_pass.
